gloss: grainy bumps; tiny round particles; bumpy texture

definitions.gloss: grainy bumps; tiny round particles; bumpy texture
definitions.explanation: Many small round bumps or grains on or in something — used for textures of food (orange juice with pulp, strawberry seeds, tapioca) and skin (acne, goosebumps, hives).

examples.japanese: イチゴのつぶつぶが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like the little bumps on strawberries.

examples.japanese: つぶつぶの{入|はい}ったオレンジジュースを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought orange juice with pulp in it.

examples.japanese: {寒|さむ}くて{腕|うで}につぶつぶの{鳥肌|とりはだ}が{立|た}った。
examples.english: It was so cold that goosebumps came up on my arms.

notes:
Reduplication of {粒|つぶ} (grain, particle). Describes the visual or tactile texture of many small round things clustered together. Often appears as つぶつぶ(の) before a noun, or as a noun on its own meaning 'those little bumps/grains.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- つぶつぶの{入|はい}った〜: 〜 with bits/pulp in it
- つぶつぶ{感|かん}: bumpy/grainy texture
- {肌|はだ}のつぶつぶ: bumps on the skin (e.g. acne)
- イチゴのつぶつぶ: the little seeds on a strawberry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ざらざら: rough; gritty — a coarser, more abrasive texture
- ぶつぶつ: bigger, more uneven bumps (also rash, pimples); also means muttering
- ぼつぼつ: scattered spots or dots, often used for skin spots
